study_identification_part.si_4_title: Comprehensive volumetric phenotyping of the neonatal brain in Down syndrome

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: developing Human Connectome Project (dHCP) used as the normative control dataset (n=493); Early Brain Imaging in DS (eBiDS) and T21 study used as the Down syndrome patient datasets (n=25). dHCP is not explicitly listed in the guide's categories but is a multi-site project; eBiDS and T21 are single-site (St Thomas' Hospital).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: we used a cross-sectional sample of 493 preterm- to term-born control neonates from the developing Human Connectome Project to perform normative modeling... Deviation from the normative mean was quantified in 25 neonates with DS... from the Early Brain Imaging in DS (eBiDS) study... quantification of fetal brain development using MRI (trisomy 21 participant subgroup, henceforth denoted 'T21 study') [07/H0707/105], Early Brain Imaging in DS (eBiDS) [19/LO/0667] and the dHCP [14/LO/1169].
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: FukamiGartner2023.pdf.md: Abstract; Materials and methods / Ethical approval

answer.dHCP: normative training and development of the model

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: dHCP provided 493 control neonates to build the GPR normative models. eBiDS and the T21 study provided 25 neonates with Down syndrome to evaluate deviations from the norm.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: In this study we used a cross-sectional sample of 493 preterm- to term-born control neonates from the developing Human Connectome Project to perform normative modeling... Deviation from the normative mean was quantified in 25 neonates with DS... from the Early Brain Imaging in DS (eBiDS) study.

model-1.model-name: regional brain tissue volumes (absolute and relative)

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Gaussian process regression (GPR) was used to model absolute and relative tissue volumes in the 493 dHCP control neonates. These 493 controls constitute the sample used to establish the normative mean and standard deviation.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: A total of 493 preterm- to term-born neonates ... were selected from the dHCP ... for normative modeling of brain tissue volumes from 32 to 46 weeks PMA at scan.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.location: FukamiGartner2023.pdf.md: Materials and methods / Participants / Preterm- and term-born neonates for normative modeling

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Age info refers to Postmenstrual Age (PMA) at scan in weeks. Table 2 provides the median, IQR (39.14-42.57), and range (31.14-45.14) for the control group (n=493). Mean and SD are not reported.

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: The control group (n=493) included 243 females (49.3%). The number of males (250) and their percentage (50.7%) were calculated from the total sample size. All 493 were used for normative modeling.
